items.title: Boeing (BA) Is Putting $5 Million Into St. Louis Manufacturing Talent
items.summary: Boeing is investing $5 million in a new advanced manufacturing facility in St. Louis. The facility is intended to support long term skills development in the U.S. heartland beyond Boeing's core aerospace operations.
